definitions.explanation: Cattle of designated Japanese breeds raised for high-quality beef, and the prized, well-marbled meat they produce.

examples.japanese: {和牛|わぎゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{和牛|わぎゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had a wagyu steak on my birthday.

examples.japanese: {和牛|わぎゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きめ{細|こま}かい→きめ細かい：16052_kimekomakai⟧⟦{霜降|しもふ}り→霜降り：18934_shimofuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Wagyu is known for its fine marbling and is highly popular overseas as well.

notes:
Refers to cattle of designated Japanese breeds, and to their tender, heavily marbled beef. {和|わ} means 'Japanese,' contrasting with imported beef. Famous regional brands include {神戸牛|こうべぎゅう} and {松阪牛|まつさかうし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和牛|わぎゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧: wagyu steak
- ⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧{和牛|わぎゅう}: domestically raised wagyu
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{和牛|わぎゅう}: premium wagyu

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国産牛|こくさんぎゅう}: domestically raised beef — born and raised in Japan but not necessarily a Japanese breed
- ⟦{霜降|しもふ}り→霜降り：18934_shimofuri⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: marbled meat — meat with fat marbling, a hallmark of {和牛|わぎゅう}
